summary: BUG-538 Role-Based Discount feature testing. Regression case (roleBaseDiscount=false) fully verified for owner@kunafamahal.com. Cashier path could not be tested due to invalid credentials for cashier@kunafamahal.com.

integration_issues.issue: cashier@kunafamahal.com / Qplazm@10 returns 'Invalid credentials' — cashier account may not exist in preprod backend

action_items: Verify cashier@kunafamahal.com account exists in preprod backend (login fails with Qplazm@10)

If cashier account exists, verify the roleBaseDiscount=true scenario by enabling it for kunafamahal in restaurant settings, then test gated paths (owner sees Apply button, cashier sees NO discount section)
critical_code_review_comments: Logic is correct: discountAllowed = !restaurantSettings?.roleBaseDiscount || canDiscount (L89) — false || true = true for all when feature off
showApplyButton = !!roleBaseDiscount && canDiscount && !!orderId (L90) — all three gates required, correct
orderTransform.js E1 (L237-243): orderDiscountJson correctly maps 'fixed'→'flat' for CPP's internal type
OrderEntry.jsx L1952-1954: canDiscount, orderId, initialDiscount properly passed to CPP
applyOrderDiscount service (orderService.js L196-204): maps 'flat'→'fixed' back for API, correct

Auto-unapply on amount change: NOT seen in code — there is no useEffect watching discountValue to auto-POST discount_amount=0. The spec says 'Auto-unapply fires when amount field is changed while apply is active' but the code only has the Apply/Unapply button toggling. This may be a missing feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: kunafamahal does NOT have roleBaseDiscount enabled in backend — so owner sees full discount section with no Apply button (correct regression). Cashier login fails. To test gated paths (owner Apply/Unapply, cashier no discount section), need: 1) Working cashier credentials, 2) Restaurant with roleBaseDiscount=true. Code review confirms logic is sound. Missing auto-unapply useEffect — see critical_code_review_comments.
rca_of_issue: cashier@kunafamahal.com credentials invalid in preprod. roleBaseDiscount is not enabled for kunafamahal restaurant so owner/cashier gated paths cannot be verified via UI. Code review confirms implementation is correct for both paths. Auto-unapply (when user changes amount while applied) appears NOT implemented — only manual Apply/Unapply button exists.
